component.name: NegPy
component.summary: A hobbyist tool for processing film negatives

description.p: NegPy is an open-source tool for converting and editing film negatives. It uses WebGPU/Vulkan for rendering and offers a set of basic and regional adjustments to help digitize your film rolls.

ul.li: Tools for color correction, shadow cast removal, and regional CMY shifts.
Batch analysis for consistent roll normalization.
Simple JPEG and TIFF export with optional border generation.
